rows.sql: SELECT weight FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'dog' AND pet_age = (SELECT MIN(pet_age) FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'dog')
SELECT PetType, MAX(weight) AS max_weight FROM Pets GROUP BY PetType;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Fname FROM Student s JOIN Has_Pet hp ON s.StuID = hp.StuID JOIN Pets p ON p.PetID = hp.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat' AND s.StuID IN (SELECT hp2.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp2 JOIN Pets p2 ON p2.PetID = hp2.PetID WHERE p2.PetType = 'dog')
SELECT s.Major, s.Age FROM Student s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON p.PetID = hp.PetID WHERE hp.StuID = s.StuID AND p.PetType = 'cat')
SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE StuID NOT IN (SELECT hp.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat' AND hp.StuID IS NOT NULL)
SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE StuID NOT IN (SELECT hp.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat')
SELECT PetType, AVG(pet_age) AS avg_age, MAX(pet_age) AS max_age FROM Pets GROUP BY PetType;
SELECT PetType, AVG(weight) AS average_weight FROM Pets GROUP BY PetType;
SELECT DISTINCT s.Fname, s.Age FROM Student s JOIN Has_Pet h ON s.StuID = h.StuID
SELECT DISTINCT s.LName FROM Student s JOIN Has_Pet h ON s.StuID = h.StuID JOIN Pets p ON p.PetID = h.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat' AND p.pet_age = 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count FROM countries;
SELECT DISTINCT cn.Model FROM cars_data cd JOIN car_names cn ON cn.MakeId = cd.Id WHERE cd.Weight < (SELECT AVG(Weight) FROM cars_data) LIMIT 50;
SELECT DISTINCT cm.FullName FROM car_makers cm JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id JOIN car_names cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model JOIN cars_data cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId WHERE cd.Year = 1970;

SELECT co.Continent AS continent, COUNT(cm.Id) AS count FROM continents co LEFT JOIN countries c ON c.Continent = co.ContId LEFT JOIN car_makers cm ON cm.Country = c.CountryId GROUP BY co.ContId, co.Continent ORDER BY co.ContId
SELECT AVG(CAST(MPG AS REAL)) AS avg_mpg FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 4;
SELECT MIN(Weight) AS min_weight FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year = 1974;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_cars FROM cars_data WHERE CAST(Horsepower AS INTEGER) > 150;
SELECT AVG(CAST(Horsepower AS REAL)) AS avg_horsepower FROM cars_data WHERE Year < 1980 AND Horsepower <> '' AND Horsepower NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS model_count FROM model_list ml JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id WHERE cm.FullName = 'American Motor Company';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS model_count FROM model_list ml JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id WHERE cm.FullName = 'American Motor Company';

SELECT DISTINCT n.MakeId, n.Make FROM cars_data c JOIN car_names n ON n.MakeId = c.Id WHERE c.Horsepower NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND CAST(c.Horsepower AS INTEGER) > (SELECT MIN(CAST(Horsepower AS INTEGER)) FROM cars_data WHERE Horsepower NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*') AND c.Cylinders < 4;

SELECT cm.Id, cm.Maker FROM car_makers cm WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_list ml WHERE ml.Maker = cm.Id) >= 2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data cd JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId JOIN model_list ml2 ON cn.Model = ml2.Model WHERE ml2.Maker = cm.Id) > 3;
SELECT Airline, Abbreviation FROM airlines WHERE Country = 'USA';
SELECT AirportCode, AirportName FROM airports WHERE TRIM(City) = 'Anthony';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_flights FROM flights;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS flights_arriving_in_aberdeen FROM flights f JOIN airports a ON TRIM(f.DestAirport) = TRIM(a.AirportCode) WHERE TRIM(a.City) = 'Aberdeen'

WITH legs AS (
  SELECT TRIM(SourceAirport) AS code FROM flights
  UNION ALL
  SELECT TRIM(DestAirport) FROM flights
),
counts AS (
  SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM legs GROUP BY code
)
SELECT code AS AirportCode
FROM counts
WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM counts);

WITH legs AS (SELECT TRIM(SourceAirport) AS code FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(DestAirport) FROM flights), counts AS (SELECT TRIM(a.AirportCode) AS code, COUNT(l.code) AS n FROM airports a LEFT JOIN legs l ON TRIM(a.AirportCode) = l.code GROUP BY TRIM(a.AirportCode)) SELECT code AS AirportCode FROM counts WHERE n = (SELECT MIN(n) FROM counts)
SELECT f.FlightNo FROM flights f JOIN airlines a ON f.Airline = a.uid WHERE a.Airline = 'United Airlines'
SELECT FlightNo FROM flights WHERE TRIM(DestAirport) = 'APG';
SELECT f.FlightNo FROM flights f JOIN airports a ON TRIM(f.DestAirport) = TRIM(a.AirportCode) WHERE TRIM(a.City) = 'Aberdeen'
SELECT District FROM shop GROUP BY District HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN Number_products < 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN Number_products > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Location) AS distinct_locations FROM shop;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Template_ID) AS number_of_templates FROM Documents;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS document_count FROM Documents d JOIN Templates t ON d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID WHERE t.Template_Type_Code = 'PPT';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS document_count FROM Documents d JOIN Templates t ON d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID WHERE t.Template_Type_Code = 'PPT'
SELECT Template_ID FROM Templates WHERE Template_ID NOT IN (SELECT Template_ID FROM Documents WHERE Template_ID IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY Template_ID
SELECT DISTINCT Template_Type_Code FROM Templates;
SELECT Template_Type_Description FROM Ref_Template_Types WHERE Template_Type_Code = 'AD'
SELECT Template_Type_Code FROM Ref_Template_Types WHERE Template_Type_Description = 'Book';
SELECT d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name, COUNT(p.Paragraph_ID) AS Paragraph_Count FROM Documents d LEFT JOIN Paragraphs p ON p.Document_ID = d.Document_ID GROUP BY d.Document_ID, d.Document_Name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS teacher_count FROM teacher;
SELECT t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Course_ID) AS Course_Count FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN course_arrange ca ON ca.Teacher_ID = t.Teacher_ID GROUP BY t.Teacher_ID, t.Name;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS museum_count FROM museum WHERE CAST(substr(Open_Year, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 2013 OR CAST(substr(Open_Year, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 2008;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_players FROM players;
SELECT first_name, birth_date FROM players WHERE country_code = 'USA' LIMIT 50
SELECT AVG(winner_rank) AS average_winner_rank FROM matches;
SELECT MIN(loser_rank) AS highest_loser_rank FROM matches WHERE loser_rank IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loser_name) AS distinct_loser_names FROM matches;
SELECT p.first_name, p.country_code FROM rankings r JOIN players p ON p.player_id = r.player_id WHERE r.tours = (SELECT MAX(tours) FROM rankings)
SELECT country_code FROM players GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT note FROM death WHERE note LIKE '%East%'
SELECT line_1, line_2 FROM Addresses LIMIT 50
SELECT section_name, section_description FROM Sections;
